title: Context-Aware Error Mitigation Orchestration for Hybrid Quantum Reinforcement Learning on NISQ Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.01253v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quantum Reinforcement Learning (QRL) integrates reinforcement learning with parameterized quantum circuits and is a promising approach to combinatorial optimization. On Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) devices, however, decoherence, gate imperfections, and measurement errors reduce policy quality and make learning less reliable. Existing error mitigation techniques are generally applied as fixed corrections that do not adapt to changing noise conditions or to the evolving state of training. This work presents Adaptive Policy-Guided Error Mitigation (APGEM) as a context-aware orchestration layer of the hybrid quantum-classical training loop that dynamically selects the most suitable mitigation strategy during QRL training. translated_title: 面向NISQ系统上混合量子强化学习的上下文感知误差缓解编排
translated_abstract: 量子强化学习（QRL）将强化学习与参数化量子电路相结合，是解决组合优化问题的一种有前景的方法。然而，在噪声中等规模量子（NISQ）设备上，退相干、门操作缺陷和测量误差会降低策略质量，使学习的可靠性下降。现有的误差缓解技术通常作为固定修正来应用，无法适应不断变化的噪声条件或训练过程中不断演化的状态。本工作提出了自适应策略引导误差缓解（APGEM），作为混合量子-经典训练循环的上下文感知编排层，可在QRL训练过程中动态选择最合适的缓解策略。APGEM使用策略级指标（包括量子态保真度……）对零噪声外推（ZNE）、概率误差消除（PEC）、Clifford数据回归（CDR）和读出误差缓解（REM）进行评估。
tldr: 提出了一种上下文感知的自适应策略引导误差缓解编排层APGEM，能够在NISQ设备上的量子强化学习训练过程中根据策略级指标动态选择最合适的误差缓解策略。
en_tdlr: Proposes APGEM, a context-aware orchestration layer that adaptively guides error mitigation in hybrid quantum reinforcement learning by dynamically selecting the most suitable mitigation strategy based on policy-level indicators during training on NISQ devices.
